evals.name: platform-overview
evals.prompt: In the homelab repo, make me a Draw.io (.drawio) architecture diagram that puts the whole duynhlab platform on one page: the Envoy Gateway edge, the Go microservices, the datastores (PostgreSQL via CloudNativePG, Valkey, ClickHouse), the observability stack (VictoriaMetrics/Logs/Traces, Grafana, Pyroscope), and the control-plane controllers (Flux, KEDA, Kyverno, cert-manager, External Secrets, OpenBao, Temporal). Save it as docs/architecture/platform-overview.drawio. It's a Draw.io file specifically, not Mermaid.
evals.expected_output: A native (uncompressed) .drawio with domain-grouped boxes in the homelab semantic palette, embedded PNG logos on the deployed products, a legend, and clean layout. validate_house.py passes.

assertions.text: Output file exists and contains <mxGraphModel> (native, uncompressed .drawio)
scripts/validate_house.py on the file exits 0 with no ERROR lines
Uses the homelab palette fills (service #06B6D4, data #22C55E, and at least one platform #7C3AED)
Embeds at least three logos as image=data:image/png, (comma form, never ;base64,)
Groups nodes into domain frames (edge, services, data, observability, control-plane) rather than a flat list

evals.name: flux-dependency-tree
evals.prompt: Draw me the Flux Kustomization dependency chain for the local cluster as a Draw.io .drawio file: the dependsOn edges from flux-system through controllers-local and the infra waves (secrets, monitoring, databases, keda, temporal) down to apps-local. Nodes named exactly as the Kustomizations. Save it as docs/architecture/flux-dependency-tree.drawio.
evals.expected_output: A native .drawio directed graph of Kustomizations with dependsOn edges, house palette (platform role for controllers), a legend, planned nodes dashed if any. validate_house.py passes.

assertions.text: scripts/validate_house.py on the file exits 0 with no ERROR lines
Nodes are named as real Kustomizations (flux-system, controllers-local, apps-local at minimum)
Has directed edges expressing dependsOn (edge cells with source and target)

evals.name: observability-signal-path
evals.prompt: I need a Draw.io diagram (save under docs/architecture/) showing how the four observability signals flow through the homelab platform: metrics, logs, traces and profiles leaving the services, through the collectors (Vector, OpenTelemetry), into the VictoriaMetrics / VictoriaLogs / VictoriaTraces / Pyroscope backends, and surfaced in Grafana. Use the signal colours.
evals.expected_output: A native .drawio request-path diagram using the four observability signal roles (metric/log/trace/profile) with correct fills, collector and backend boxes with logos, Grafana as the sink, a legend. validate_house.py passes.

assertions.text: scripts/validate_house.py on the file exits 0 with no ERROR lines
Uses the four signal fills: metric #FFE8CC, log #D3F9D8, trace #C5F6FA, profile #F3D9FA
Shows VictoriaMetrics, VictoriaLogs, VictoriaTraces, Pyroscope and Grafana as distinct boxes
Directed edges express the signal flow from services through collectors to backends to Grafana
